goal: A delta Review round (round 3 or later with computed delta_paths) tells the reviewer that changed paths outside delta_paths were inspected by earlier rounds at the prior reviewed commit and are attested in approval.inspected_paths by carry-forward rather than re-read, and that an unread or truncated path is not a defect and never a blocking finding, so a wide change such as branch-boundary-r2 S4 serial-runner-retirement (29 paths, -12303 lines) no longer blocks on a coverage-only finding that names no defect.

acceptance.assertion: The Review prompt for a round with computed delta_paths states that changed paths outside delta_paths are attested in approval.inspected_paths by carry-forward from the prior reviewed commit without re-reading their full diff, and that incomplete reading is not a defect and never a blocking finding.

The Review prompt for rounds 1 and 2 and for a skipped delta carries none of the carry-forward text, and verdict validation is unchanged: a pass still lists every changed path in approval.inspected_paths and an out-of-delta blocking finding is still rejected.
The committed Claude MCP bundle matches the runtime source.
